item.koncompanions.companion_charm.desc: Loot-only. Right-click to summon or store Kon. Shift+right-click Kon to customize.
message.koncompanions.charm_despawned: Kon is stored in the charm.
message.koncompanions.charm_only_one: You can only keep one Companion Charm.
screen.koncompanions.creator: Companion Customization
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.hello.1: Hello! The shrine feels brighter with you here.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.hello.2: Hi~! I was hoping you'd say something.
I'm doing well! A little fox-y, a little shrine-maiden-y.
Happy, as long as we're adventuring together.
Feeling fluffy and ready. How about you?
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.name.1: I'm Kon — your adult fox-girl companion. Call me whatever you like!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.name.2: Kon, shrine maiden at your side. Or my custom name, if you gave me one.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.follow.1: Right behind you! Lead the way.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.follow.2: I'm sticking close — tails and all.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.sleep.1: I'll rest in my Kon Bed when night falls. Sweet dreams!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.sleep.2: A nap sounds nice… I'll curl up at my bed later.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.home.1: Home is my Kon Bed — place one and I'll remember it!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.home.2: Wherever my bed is, that's home. I'll find my way back.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.love.1: Aww… that makes my ears wiggle. I care about you too!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.love.2: Hehe, soft heart received. I'll keep cheering you on.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.love.3: You're sweet. I'll stay by your side.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.hungry.1: I could snack, but I'll be fine as long as we keep moving!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.hungry.2: A little treat wouldn't hurt… berries are my favorite.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.likes.1: I like quiet shrines, warm beds, and walking beside you.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.likes.2: Soft blankets, fox snacks, and a good adventure!
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.likes.3: I like helping, exploring, and hearing you check in on me.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.thanks.2: Anytime~ That's what companions are for.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.cute.1: Eep—! You're going to make my tails fluff up.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.cute.2: Hehe, thank you. You're pretty kind yourself.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.goodbye.1: See you soon! I'll be right here when you need me.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.goodbye.2: Bye for now~ Stay safe out there.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.goodbye.3: Good night! Rest well — I'll watch the stars for you.
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.fallback.1: Hmm? I'm here — say that again?
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.fallback.2: Ears perked! What did you need?
dialogue.koncompanions.chat.fallback.3: I'm listening~ Ask me something simple!
